subject: Compact enablement: narrow afternoon window for console + API walk
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@clearlinepay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Nadia Chen <nadia.chen@clearlinepay.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Quick: 90-min enablement for Console + API (narrow afternoon window)

Hi Kimberly / Ben —

Thanks again for the intro. We want to get a compact 90-minute enablement lined up next week that covers the Console walkthrough (keys, routes, monitoring) and a short API enablement/demo (token usage, example integrations).

Constraints: our engineering team is tight next week and can only do an afternoon slot (US PST preferred) on Tue/Wed/Thu between 1:30–4:30pm PST. There are two engineers (Nadia and me) and a solutions architect who may join for a portion.

Can you:
- Confirm which of those days you can support a single 90-min slot
- Share a short prereqs checklist we can use (creds, sample dataset, any network requirements)

I've attached our internal list of questions (clearline-prereqs.pdf).

Best,
Alex Rivera
Head of Integrations
Clearline Pay

Attachment: clearline-prereqs.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@clearlinepay.com>, Nadia Chen <nadia.chen@clearlinepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: 90-min enablement for Console + API (narrow afternoon window)

Hi Alex —

Thanks — great to see the constraints up front. We can do a compact 90-minute session and cover the Console + API flow end-to-end. Proposed slots (PST):

- Tue 2 Dec — 1:30–3:00pm
- Wed 3 Dec — 2:00–3:30pm
- Thu 4 Dec — 3:00–4:30pm

If none of those work we can make Tue 4:00–5:30pm a hard option but prefer staying earlier.

I attached a short runbook and a minimal prereqs checklist (redwood-console-runbook-v2.docx) — covers accounts, test tokens, and a small prompt set we use for live demos. Please run the checklist with your engineers before the session; it will save time.

Also looping Marissa as backup session lead (she can take the Console walkthrough if I'm in back-to-back meetings).

If you confirm a slot I’ll send a calendar invite with the Zoom link and a shared Drive folder for the artifacts.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-console-runbook-v2.docx (DOCX, 420KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex@clearlinepay.com>, Nadia Chen <nadia.chen@clearlinepay.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Nov 2025 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: 90-min enablement for Console + API (narrow afternoon window)

Kim / Marissa —

FYI, Clearline just told us they may pull in an additional APAC engineer for a short segment; that'll push the effective overlap earlier in our afternoon (they need a 3:00pm PST latest start to keep evening APAC reasonable).

My availability next week: Tue 1:30–4:30pm PST (open), Wed 2:00–4:00pm PST (partial), Thu 3:00–4:30pm PST (ok but I have a hard stop at 4:45). If we want to maximize attendance, Wed 2:00–3:30pm PST looks safest.

Suggestion: lock Wed 3 Dec, 2:00–3:30pm PST. Kimberly, if you can own the Console walkthrough and I take the API/keys + integration examples, that splits the content cleanly. Marissa can handle notes and the post-session follow-up doc.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Alex Rivera <alex@clearlinepay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Nadia Chen <nadia.chen@clearlinepay.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Nov 2025 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: 90-min enablement for Console + API (narrow afternoon window)

Thanks all — Wed 3 Dec 2:00–3:30pm PST works for us and we'll ask the APAC engineer to join the tail end. Please send the calendar invite and Drive folder.

A few quick asks for the session agenda so we can share internally:
- 10 min: intros & goals
- 40 min: Console walkthrough (keys, routes, dashboards)
- 30 min: API enablement + short integration example (code snippets)
- 10 min: Q&A and next steps / mutual action items

Also, can you confirm whether we should bring any sample payloads or datasets? We can bring a small CSV of anonymized transaction lines if that helps for a live run.

Appreciate it — looking forward.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Head of Integrations, Clearline Pay
alex@clearlinepay.com
